articles.summary: Awell builds care orchestration infrastructure, and on top of it Panels, a work surface where care teams define a patient population, configure how they work it, and trigger what happens next. Panels is population and workflow agnostic by design: intake, surgery prep, prescription refill, chronic care management and post-discharge follow-up each need to see different data and follow different steps.
articles.title: Awell Panels: Worklists That Update Themselves
